remarks: Nestled at the end of a quiet street in one of the most prestigious towns in the country, this rare 8.5-acre estate in Greenwich, offers an exceptional opportunity for those seeking space, privacy, and potential. Built in 1936, this stately residence features 5 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and over 3,700 square feet of living space, all set on a sprawling flat parcel rarely found in the area. The home boasts timeless charm with hardwood floors throughout, two fireplaces, and elegant architectural details. A sunlit great room showcases cathedral ceilings, a grand fireplace, and French doors that open onto a rear patio-perfect for entertaining or simply enjoying views of the private grounds. The primary bedroom is a retreat of its own, with floor-to-ceiling windows and direct access to the patio. The living room includes the 2nd fireplace and built-in shelving, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.  Out back, a beautiful inground pool offers summer enjoyment, while the expansive acreage provides ample space for recreation, gardening, or future expansion. The 3-car attached garage adds convenience, and the setting-tucked away at the end of the street-ensures quiet and seclusion. While the property does need repairs and updates, it presents a rare chance to restore, renovate, or even build new on one of Greenwich's most desirable lots.
